[SWS_UCM_00273] Persistent data clean-up after Software Cluster up- date that removes a process
⌈
UCM shall remove persistent data of a removed pro-
cess by aggregating the information given in the execution manifest, namely Per-
sistencyKeyValueStorage.uri and PersistencyFileStorage.uri, in order to leave the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform and the file system clean.
⌋
